examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, vaṇijjā upāsakena akaraṇīyā. katamā pañca? satthavaṇijjā, sattavaṇijjā, maṃsavaṇijjā, majjavaṇijjā, visavaṇijjā.
addasā kho aññataro upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ kīṭāgirismiṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ. disvāna yena so bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā etadavoca, api, bhante, piṇḍo labbhatī'ti?

16405.meaning1: male and female devotees; men and women disciples

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gāmaṇi, yaṃ aduṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ, evam'eva mayhaṃ upāsaka-upāsikāyo. tesaṃ p'āhaṃ dhammaṃ desemi, ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ, sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsemi.

16406.meaning1: family of lay disciples; household of supporters
16406.meaning2: family of lay disciples; household of supporters

examples.text: yathā ca bhavaṃ gotamo ukkaṭṭhāya aññāni upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati, evam'eva bhavaṃ gotamo pokkharasātikulaṃ upasaṅkamatu.

16407.meaning1: outcaste lay disciple; low class lay devotee

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca. katamehi pañcahi?

16408.meaning1: fact of being a devotee; fact of being a disciple
16408.meaning2: fact of being a devotee; fact of being a disciple
16408.commentary: (VINt) upāsakattaṃ desesin'ti ratanattayaṃ upāsatī'ti upāsako'ti evaṃ dassitaṃ upāsakabhāvaṃ mayi abhiniviṭṭhaṃ vācāya pakāsesinti attho, upāsakohaṃ ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇaṃ gato'ti evaṃ upāsakattaṃ paṭivedesinti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: te tattha sabb'eva ahaṃ pure'ti, upāsakattaṃ paṭivedayitvā, pakkāmi sattho anumodamāno, yakkh'iddhiyā anumato punappunaṃ.
ekanahutaṃ upāsakattaṃ paṭivedesi.

16409.meaning1: reject lay disciple; worst kind of lay devotee

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikiṭṭho ca. katamehi pañcahi?

16410.meaning1: reject lay disciple; worst kind of lay devotee

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca. katamehi pañcahi?

16411.meaning1: a lotus of a lay disciple; a blossom of lay devotee

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'ca. katamehi pañcahi?

tatra ce ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitena'pi sā attamanā hoti. atittā'va, bhikkhave, upāsakaparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti. sace, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti.

16413.meaning1: a lotus of a lay disciple; a blossom of a lay devotee

examples.text: saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, akotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, kammaṃ pacceti no maṅgalaṃ, na ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, idha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'cā'ti.

16414.meaning1: state of being a lay disciple; lay devotee

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ukkaṇṭhito anabhirato sāmaññā cavitukāmo bhikkhubhāvaṃ aṭṭīyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno gihibhāvaṃ patthayamāno upāsakabhāvaṃ patthayamāno ārāmikabhāvaṃ patthayamāno sāmaṇerabhāvaṃ patthayamāno titthiyabhāvaṃ patthayamāno titthiyasāvakabhāvaṃ patthayamāno assamaṇabhāvaṃ patthayamāno asakyaputtiyabhāvaṃ patthayamāno, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ buddhaṃ paccakkheyyanti vadati viññāpeti.

te ārāmikabhūtā vā upāsakabhūtā vā pañcasikkhāpade samādāya vattanti. iti samaṇo gotamo sāvakānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito, samaṇañ'ca pana gotamaṃ sāvakā sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharantī'ti.

16416.meaning1: a stain of a lay disciple; a filthy lay devotee

examples.text: assaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kotūhalamaṅgaliko hoti, maṅgalaṃ pacceti no kammaṃ, ito ca bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, tattha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakacaṇḍālo ca hoti upāsakamalañ'ca upāsakapatikuṭṭho ca.

16417.meaning1: a gem of a lay disciple; a jewel of a lay devotee
16417.commentary: (ANt) ayaṃ pana viseso, catunnam'pi parisānaṃ ratijanan'aṭṭhena upāsako'va ratanaṃ upāsakaratanaṃ.

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako upāsakaratanañ'ca hoti upāsakapadumañ'ca upāsakapuṇḍarīkañ'cā'ti.

16418.meaning1: one hundred lay disciples; one hundred lay devotees
16418.commentary: (ANa) pañcamattehi upāsakasatehī'ti sot'āpanna-sakadāgāmīnaṃ'y'eva ariyasāvakaupāsakānaṃ pañcahi satehi parivuto bhuttapātarāso gandhamālavilepenacuṇṇāni gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. ten'ev'antaravassena parinibbāyi.
atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

16420.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Brāhmaṇasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 1 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

16422.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

16423.meaning1: attends (to); pays attention (to); sits at the feet (of)
16423.meaning2: attends or serve; sits at the feet (of)
16423.commentary: (THIa) ye sukkaṃ na upāsanti, desentiṃ buddhasāsanan'ti buddhassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ yāthāvato desentiṃ pakāsentiṃ sukkaṃ theriṃ ye na upāsanti na payirupāsanti. te ime rājagahe manussā kiṃ katā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: kiṃ'me katā rājagahe manussā, madhuṃ pītā'va acchare, ye sukkaṃ na upāsanti, desentiṃ buddhasāsanaṃ.

16424.commentary: (SNa) upāsanasmin'ti sippānaṃ abhiyoge ācariyānañ'ca payirupāsane. te kira tadā pāto'va uṭṭhāya sippasālaṃ gacchanti, tattha sippaṃ uggahetvā sajjhāy'ādīhi abhiyogaṃ katvā mukhaṃ dhovitvā yāgupānāya gacchanti. yāguṃ pivitvā puna sippasālaṃ gantvā sippaṃ gaṇhitvā sajjhāyaṃ karontā pātarāsāya gacchanti. katapātarāsā samānā mā pamādena ciraṃ nidd'okkamanaṃ ahosī'ti khadiraghaṭikāsu sīse ca pāde ca upadahitvā thokaṃ nipajjitvā puna sippasālaṃ gantvā sippaṃ gahetvā sajjhāyanti. sāyaṃ sajjhāyaṃ karontā ca gehaṃ gantvā bhuttasāyamāsā paṭhamayāmaṃ sajjhāyaṃ katvā sayanakāle tath'eva kaliṅgaraṃ upadhānaṃ katvā sayanti. evaṃ te akkhaṇavedhino vālavedhino ca ahesuṃ. idaṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kaliṅgar'ūpadhānā, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi licchavī viharanti appamattā ātāpino upāsanasmiṃ. tesaṃ rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto na labhati otāraṃ na labhati ārammaṇaṃ.

16425.meaning2: service; attendance; sitting at the feet (of)

examples.text: addasā kho āyasmā ānando sambahule licchavikumārake santh'āgāre upāsanaṃ karonte, dūrato'va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipātente, poṅkh'ānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ.

16427.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ariṭṭho upariṭṭho tagarasikhī yasassī, sudassano piyadassī ca susambuddho, gandhāro piṇḍolo upāsabho ca, nīto tatho sutavā bhāvit'atto.

16428.meaning1: attending; serving; following; sitting at the feet (of)
16428.meaning2: attending; serving; following; sitting at the feet (of)
16428.commentary: (DNa) tumhe pana seṭṭham'upāsamānā'ti uttamaṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ upāsamānā anuttare buddhasāsane vā.

examples.text: sakkassa putto'mhi mah'ānubhāvo, mahājutīko tidiv'ūpapanno, tumhe pana seṭṭham'upāsamānā, anuttaraṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā.

16429.meaning1: one hundred female lay disciples; one hundred female lay devotees

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi, ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikasatāni paṭivedesi, ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo aparena samayena parinibbāyi.

16430.commentary: (VIN 1.3.1) upāsikā nāma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā.

examples.text: yo kho, ānanda, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno viharati sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī so tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti apaciyati paramāya pūjāya.
saddhāya sīlena ca yā'dha vaḍḍhati, paññāya cāgena sutena c'ūbhayaṃ, sā tādisī sīlavatī upāsikā, ādīyati sāram'idh'eva attano'ti.
tatra ce, ānando, dhammaṃ bhāsati, bhāsitena'pi sā attamanā hoti. atittā'va, bhikkhave, upāsikāparisā hoti, atha kho ānando tuṇhī hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā ānande.

16432.meaning1: one hundred female lay disciples; one hundred lay devotees

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. ten'ev'antaravassena parinibbāyi.

16434.meaning2: attended or serve; sat at the feet (of)

16435.meaning1: who sits at the feet (of); who attends (to)
16435.meaning2: who serves; who honours; who sits at the feet (of)

examples.text: pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, aññātu'kāmo paripucchitā ahu, sussūsitā pabbajitaṃ upāsitā, atth'antaro atthakathaṃ nisāmayi.

16436.meaning1: to sit near; to sit at the feet (of)
16436.meaning2: to sit near; to sit at the feet of

examples.text: yassu maññāmi samaṇe, pavivittavihārino, sambuddhā iti maññāno, gacchāmi te upāsituṃ.
tato ratyā vivasāne, sūriyass'uggamanaṃ pati, sabbaṃ taṇhaṃ visosetvā, pallaṅkena upāvisin'ti.

samās'antagatānaṃ nāmānam'anto saro kvaci akāro hoti. devānaṃ rājā devarājo, devarājā, devānaṃ sakhā devasakho, devasakhā, pañca ahāni pañc'āhaṃ, satt'āhaṃ, pañcagavaṃ, chatt'upāhanaṃ, upasaradaṃ, visāl'akkho, vimukho.
avantidakkhiṇāpathe, bhante, kaṇhuttarā bhūmi kharā gokaṇṭakahatā, app'eva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe guṇaṅ'guṇa-upāhanaṃ anujāneyya

16440.meaning2: sound of the knocking of sandals

examples.text: potaliyo'pi kho gahapati sampannanivāsanapāvuraṇo chatt'upāhanāhi jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena so vanasaṇḍo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
avantidakkhiṇāpathe, bhante, kaṇhuttarā bhūmi kharā gokaṇṭakahatā, app'eva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe guṇaṅ'guṇa-upāhanaṃ anujāneyya
na upāhan'āruḷhassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na upāhan'āruḷhassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca akkantassa vā paṭimukkassa vā omukkassa vā agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

16443.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone) wearing sandals

16444.synonym: anukūla, anucchavi, anucchavika, anurūpa, anuloma, kappa, tajja, tathārūpa, tadanurūpa, paṭirūpa, patirūpa, patirūpaka, patirūpī, pattayutta, yuttaka, yuttarūpa, sāmaggiya, sāruppa

examples.text: ukkaṭṭho nāma patto aḍḍh'āḷhak'odanaṃ gaṇhāti catubhāgaṃ khādanaṃ tadupiyaṃ byañjanaṃ.
tattha tisso vedanāyo tassa sukhāya vedanāya somanasso savicāro, dukkhāya vedanāya domanasso savicāro, adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya upekkho savicāro.

phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe'ti sukhaphassañ'ca dukkhaphassañ'cā'ti idaṃ phassadvayaṃ upekkhe, upekkhā'm'ev'ettha uppādeyyā'ti attho. phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ upekkho'ti vā pāṭho, phassahetukaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ upekkho, sukhe anurodhaṃ dukkhe ca virodhaṃ anuppādento upekkhako bhaveyyā'ti'pi attho.

16446.meaning1: mentally poised; mentally balanced; equanimous; non-reactive; looking on; disregarding
16446.construction:
upa + ikkha + ā + ka
upekkhā + ka

examples.text: upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajāno'ti
vissajja ganthāni mun'īdha loke, vivādajātesu na vaggasārī, santo asantesu upekkhako so, anuggaho uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

16447.meaning1: looks on; is disinterested; is indifferent
16447.commentary: (NIDD1) upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe'ti. aññe taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena gaṇhanti parāmasanti abhinivisanti. arahā upekkhati na gaṇhāti na parāmasati n'ābhinivisatī'ti, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

examples.text: phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.
na brāhmaṇo kappam'upeti saṅkhā, na diṭṭhisārī na'pi ñāṇabandhu, ñatvā ca so sammutiyo puthujjā, upekkhatī uggahaṇanti m'aññe.

16449.meaning1: looking on; mental poise; mental balance; equanimity; equipoise; non-reactivity
16449.commentary: (NIDD1) upekkhā'ti yā catutthe jhāne upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā cittasamatā cittappassaddhatā majjhattatā cittassa.

examples.text: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ upekkhā'ti
upekkhaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. upekkhañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo paṭigho so pahīyissati.

16450.meaning1: liberation of the mind by equanimity (for); emancipation of the heart by non-reactivity

examples.text: nissaraṇañ'h'etaṃ, āvuso, rāgassa yadidaṃ upekkhācetovimuttī'ti.

16451.meaning1: serving as a basis for equanimity;  giving support to mental poise
16451.commentary: (ANa) yaṃ disvā domanassaṃ uppajjati, taṃ domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ nāma. yaṃ disvā upekkhā uppajjati, taṃ upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ nāmā'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati

16452.meaning1: serving as a basis for equanimity;  giving support to mental poise

examples.text: aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.

16453.meaning1: producing equanimity; resulting in mental poise
16453.commentary: (ANa) yaṃ disvā domanassaṃ uppajjati, taṃ domanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ nāma. yaṃ disvā upekkhā uppajjati, taṃ upekkhāṭṭhāniyaṃ nāmā'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: cha upekkh'ūpavicārā. cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā upekkhāṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya upekkhāṭhāniyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati.

cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

16455.meaning1: theme of mental balance; cause for mental poise

examples.text: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tīṇi nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni, kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ paggahanimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ upekkhānimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ.
tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

16457.meaning1: highest state of equanimity; perfection of equanimity

examples.text: so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

16458.meaning1: devoted to the development of equanimity; engaged in the cultivation of non-reactivity

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe upekkhābhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

16459.meaning1: based on equanimity; founded on non-reactivity

examples.text: katamāni dve? sāt'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ upekkh'ārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

16460.meaning1: which possesses purification of awareness by equanimity; (or) with purity of equanimity and mindfulness
16460.commentary: (VINa) upekkhāsatipārisuddhin'ti upekkhāya janitasatipārisuddhiṃ. imasmiñ'hi jhāne suparisuddhā sati. yā ca tassā satiyā pārisuddhi, sā upekkhāya katā na aññena, tasmā etaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhin'ti vuccati.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sa kho so, gahapati, ariyasāvako imaṃ'y'eva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyath'idaṃ, ekam'pi jātiṃ dve'pi jātiyo…

16461.meaning1: perfectly purified by equanimity and mindfulness; (or) with pure equanimity and mindfulness

examples.text: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanan'ti.

16462.meaning1: equanimity as an element of awakening; mental poise as a factor of enlightenment

examples.text: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathāsamāhitaṃ cittaṃ sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti, upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti.
yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

16463.meaning1: serving as a basis for equanimity as an element of awakening; giving support to mental poise as a factor of enlightenment

examples.text: upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppanno c'eva upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo uppajjati, uppanno ca upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatī'ti.

16464.meaning1: serving as a basis for equanimity as an element of awakening; giving support to mental poise as a factor of enlightenment
16464.commentary: (SNa) upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā'ti upekkhāya ārammaṇadhammā, atthato pana majjhatt'ākāro upekkhāṭṭhānīyā dhammo'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

16465.meaning1: accompanied by mental balance; full of equanimity

examples.text: so upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.

imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkam'pi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi, avitakkam'pi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi, sappītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, nippītikam'pi bhāveyyāsi, sātasahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi, upekkhāsahagatam'pi bhāveyyāsi.

16466.meaning1: comfort and mental poise; ease and equanimity

examples.text: tassa yā purimā samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti.

16467.meaning1: ease of equipoise; comfort of non-reactivity; (comm) pleasure of the fourth jhāna

examples.text: kiñ'ca tattha iñjitasmiṃ? yadeva tattha upekkhāsukhaṃ aniruddhaṃ hoti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.

16468.meaning1: refined and true perception of the comfort of equanimity
16468.meaning2: refined and true perception of equanimity

examples.text: tassa yā purimā samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

16469.meaning1: with a refined and true perception of the ease of equanimity
16469.meaning2: with a refined and true perception of equanimity

examples.text: tassa yā purimā samādhija-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, upekkhāsukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

16470.meaning1: bound by gratification to the pleasure of equanimity

examples.text: tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

16471.meaning1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the pleasure of equanimity

examples.text: tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

16472.meaning1: bound by the gratification from the pleasure of equanimity

examples.text: tassa upekkh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti upekkhāsukh'assādagadhitaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ upekkhāsukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

16475.commentary: (ANa) upekkhāsetadantavā'ti cha'ḷ'aṅg'upekkhāmayehi setadantehi samannāgato. (THa) upekkhā setadantā te etassa atthī'ti, upekkhāsetadantavā.

examples.text: sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.
na kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, abhijānāmi tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, upekkhāvihārasmiṃ hoti.

16477.meaning1: living in a state of equanimity; dwelling with perfect mental poise

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, brahmā upekkhāvihārī'ti. taṃ me idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā sakkhidiṭṭho, bhagavā hi, bhante, upekkhāvihārī'ti.

16478.meaning1: neutral; to be experienced with equanimity; serving as a basis for mental poise
16478.commentary: (SNt) evaṃ rūpā ca manāpā upekkhāvedaniyā'ti etthā'pi yath'ārahaṃ vattabbaṃ.

examples.text: saṃvijjati kho, gahapati, manodhātu, dhammā ca upekkhāvedaniyā, manoviññāṇañ'ca adukkham'asukhavedaniyaṃ. phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati adukkham'asukhā vedanā.

16480.meaning1: power of equipoise; faculty of equanimity
16480.commentary: (PMa) sukhadukkh'ākārapavattiṃ upekkhati majjhatt'ākārasaṇṭhitattā ten'ākārena pavattatī'ti upekkhā, majjhattalakkhaṇe ind'aṭṭhaṃ kāretī'ti indriyaṃ, upekkhā eva indriyaṃ upekkh'indriyaṃ.

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upekkh'indriyaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ vā cetasikaṃ vā n'eva sātaṃ n'āsātaṃ vedayitaṃ
jīvit'indriyaṃ, sukh'indriyaṃ, dukkh'indriyaṃ, somanass'indriyaṃ, domanass'indriyaṃ, upekkh'indriyaṃ

16481.meaning1: ending of equipoise; cessation of the faculty of equanimity

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… upekkh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā

16482.meaning1: leading to the ending of equipoise; going to the cessation of the faculty of equanimity

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… upekkh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā

16483.meaning1: appearance of equipoise; arising of the faculty of equanimity

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… upekkh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, upekkh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, na me te, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā…

16485.meaning1: exploration with equanimity; examination with non-reactivity

examples.text: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ dhammaṃ upavicarati, iti cha somanass'upavicārā, cha domanass'upavicārā, cha upekkh'upavicārā.

16486.meaning1: exploration with equanimity; examination with non-reactivity

examples.text: iti cha somanass'ūpavicārā, cha domanass'ūpavicārā, cha upekkh'ūpavicārā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

16488.meaning2: having become neutral; having become indifferent

examples.text: sace ca pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, karissatha karotha vā, na vo dukkhā pamuty'atthi, upecca'pi palāyatan'ti.
tuvañ'ca bhante anukampakaṃ viduṃ, upecca vandiṃ kusalañ'ca pucchisaṃ, tato te ucchussa adāsi khaṇḍikaṃ, pasannacitā atulāya pītiyā'ti.

16490.commentary: (THIa) atha pana taṃ pāpakammaṃ āyatiṃ karissasi, eta'r'ahi karosi vā, niray'ādīsu catūsu apāyesu manussesu ca tassa phalabhūtaṃ dukkhaṃ ito etto vā palāyante mayi n'ānubandhissatī'ti adhippāyena upecca sañcicca palāyatopi te tato pāpato mutti mokkhā n'atthi, gatikāl'ādi-paccay'antara-samavāye sati vipaccate evā'ti attho. uppaccā'ti vā pāṭho, uppatitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: na te dukkhā pamuty'atthi, upecca-api palāyato, sace bhāyasi dukkhassa, sace te dukkham'appiyaṃ.
saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yaññ'opanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.
yo ca vantakasāvassa, sīlesu susamāhito, upeto damasaccena, sa ve kāsāvam'arahati.
dukkaraṃ vā'pi karonti, sekhā sīlasamāhitā, ṭhitattā anagāriy'upetassa, tuṭṭhi hoti sukh'āvahā'ti.
anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.
tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
evaṃ vutte yasmiṃ samaye upeti, saññī tasmiṃ samaye hoti. yasmiṃ samaye apeti, asaññī tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti. itth'eke abhisaññānirodhaṃ paññapenti.
middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.
vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attā nirattā na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.

16496.synonym: adhigacchati, anubhavati, abhijānāti, āpajjati, nigacchati, paṭilabhati, paṭisevati, pappoti, labhati, vindati

examples.text: tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bādhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.
yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.

16497.meaning1: is suitable; is ready; is fit (for)

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ nihitaṃ ninnītakasāvaṃ, mudu ca hoti kammaniyañ'ca pabhassarañ'ca, na ca pabhaṅgu, sammā upeti kammāya.
bhāyāmi nāgadattaṃ suppagabbhaṃ, kulesu vinibaddhaṃ, mā h'eva maccurañño balavato, antakassa vasaṃ upesī'ti.
